BrochureContent.Content:
This stunning detached 4 bedroom property in Derrybeg, County Donegal is a true gem. With exceptional sea views over the wild Atlantic Ocean and local beaches and islands, this property is sure to impress. The property is an "upside down house" with all living accommodation on the 1st floor and sleeping accommodation on the ground floor.

As you approach the property, you will be struck by its wow factor. The appearance of the property is simply stunning, with a tasteful design that perfectly complements the surrounding landscape. The property is ready to occupy, so you can move in and start enjoying the stunning views and peaceful surroundings right away.

This property is an ideal holiday home, offering a perfect escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. Whether you are looking for a peaceful retreat or an active holiday, this property has something for everyone. With its convenient location, you will be just a short distance from local amenities and beaches, making it easy to explore the local area and enjoy all that it has to offer.

The living accommodation on the 1st floor is simply breathtaking. The open plan living area is flooded with natural light, creating a bright and airy space that is perfect for relaxing and entertaining. The living area features a solid fuel stove, adding a touch of warmth and cosiness to the space. The dining area is perfect for enjoying meals and the views, while the kitchen is fully fitted and boasts an island. There is even a separate sitting area where you can relax and unwind and enjoy the sea views.

The sleeping accommodation on the ground floor is equally impressive. The master bedroom is spacious and comfortable, with a luxurious En-Suite bathroom and walk in closet area, that is perfect for relaxing after a long day. The additional bedrooms are also spacious and comfortable, providing plenty of space for family and guests.

One of the stand out features of this property is the exceptional sea views. Whether you are relaxing in the living area or enjoying a peaceful night`s sleep in one of the bedrooms, you will be treated to stunning views of the wild Atlantic Ocean and local beaches and islands. This is truly a property that must be seen to be believed.
